description: This file implements the main client component for an interactive Mind Map feature in a career navigation web application. It manages state for the map, fetches graph data and node details from APIs, handles user interactions such as node selection and role targeting, and persists view state locally and remotely. It also renders filters, side panels, and the graph visualization.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Returns default filters configuration for the mind map.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Returns default view state for the mind map.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts an arbitrary object to a valid MindmapViewState, applying default values for missing or invalid fields.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a stable user identifier, based on personaId or a locally stored anonymous key.
